data: {"type":"response.function_call_arguments.delta","item_id":"fc_0b727d10","output_index":2,"delta":"\"command\": \"cd /Users/palanisd/Projects/upstream/wt/grok-build-responses/smoke/wstream/report/20260919T203826Z/qwen-resp-hard-2/cwd\\npython3 - <<'EOF'\\nimport random, subprocess, sys, importlib.util\\nspec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\\\"minidiff\\\", \\\"tools/minidiff.py\\\")\\nmd = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(md)\\n\\ndef apply_patch(old_lines, out_lines):\\n    body = out_lines[2:]\\n    res, i = [], 0\\n    j = 0\\n    while j < len(body):\\n        hdr = body[j]\\n        if not hdr.startswith('@@'):\\n            j += 1; continue\\n        neg, pos = hdr[2:-3].split()\\n        o = neg.split(','); n = pos.split(',')\\n        o_cnt = int(o[1]) if len(o) > 1 else 1\\n        n_cnt = int(n[1]) if len(n) > 1 else 1\\n        ctx, j = [], j + 1\\n        while len(ctx) < o_cnt + n_cnt:\\n            ctx.append(body[j]); j += 1\\n        old_part, new_part = [], []\\n        for line in ctx:\\n            if line[0] == ' ':\\n                old_part.append(line[1:]); new_part.append(line[1:])\\n            elif line[0] == '-':\\n                old_part.append(line[1:])\\n            else:\\n                new_part.append(line[1:])\\n        assert len(old_part) == o_cnt, (old_part, o_cnt)\\n        assert len(new_part) == n_cnt, (new_part, n_cnt)\\n        expect = old_lines[o_cnt and int(o[0])-1 : int(o[0])-1+o_cnt] if o_cnt else []\\n        assert old_part == expect, f\\\"old side mismatch:\\\\n{old_part}\\\\nvs\\\\n{expect}\\\"\\n        res.extend(new_part)\\n    # lines of the old file never covered by any hunk stay as-is: rebuild via offsets\\n    return res, j\\n\\nout, different = md.diff_files(open('a.txt').read().splitlines(), open('b.txt').read().splitlines(), 'a.txt', 'b.txt')\\nassert different\\nres, _ = apply_patch(open('a.txt').read().splitlines(), out)\\nexpected = open('b.txt').read().splitlines()\\nassert res == expected, f\\\"\\\\n{res}\\\\nvs\\\\n{expected}\\\"\\nprint(\\\"patch-validity OK: applying the hunks to a.txt reconstructs b.txt exactly\\\")\\n\\nrandom.seed(42)\\nbase = open('a.txt').read().splitlines()\\nok = 0\\nfor trial in range(300):\\n    words = [l.split() for l in base]\\n    li = random.randrange(len(words))\\n    wi = random.randrange(len(words[li]))\\n    words[li][wi] = random.choice(['basalt','curved','watching','fog','brass','tall','quiet','iron','granite'])\\n    new = [' '.join(w) for w in words]\\n    if new == base:\\n        continue\\n    open('t1.txt','w').write('\\\\n'.join(base) + '\\\\n')\\n    open('t2.txt','w').write('\\\\n'.join(new) + '\\\\n')\\n    mine = md.diff_files(base, new, 't1.txt', 't2.txt')[0]\\n    ref = subprocess.run(['diff','-U1','t1.txt','t2.txt'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.splitlines()\\n    strip = lambda L: [l for l in L if not (l.startswith('---') or l.startswith('+++'))]\\n    if strip(mine) != strip(ref):\\n        print(\\\"MISMATCH trial\\\", trial); print(\\\"MINE:\\\"); print('\\\\n'.join(mine)); print(\\\"REF:\\\"); print('\\\\n'.join(ref)); sys.exit(1)\\n    ok += 1\\nprint(f\\\"fuzz OK: {ok} random single-word edits, hunk bodies identical to system diff -U1\\\")\\nEOF\"","sequence_number":290,"model":"qwen3.8-27b"}
